description: Land Title Settlement Department  - Hiriwala, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District   - Cad. Map No.  510223
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, extent, encumbrances, and servitude rights for multiple properties in the Gampaha District. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
